title: Comparison of addition variants (cls, step_fork, step_ar, ar, addressed_step_ar, addressed_ar)
question: Across the six addition variants—parallel classification per step (cls), parallel query branches per step (step_fork), sequential predictions per step with harness state updates (step_ar), unrolled full-trace autoregressive generation (ar), and their explicitly base-B addressed counterparts (addressed_step_ar, addressed_ar)—how do convergence speed, in-domain accuracy, and zero-shot base and length transfer compare?
